INSPECT_CANDIDATES.returns: candidate ids (alphabetical), descriptor value and source, metal price, admissible process domain

COMPUTE_ACTIVITY.returns: log10 turnover frequency of each requested candidate at the fixed atomic reference condition

cost.basis: 1 MKM evaluation per metal at the reference condition; charged 1 CU per metal (minimum billable unit)

READ_PROPERTY_UNCERTAINTY.returns: declared descriptor uncertainty distribution per requested candidate

args.bounds: optional {T_C: [values], P_bar: [min, max], Tsep_C: [min, max]} inside the admissible domain; empty = whole domain
args.name: optional window id (use 'full' for the whole domain)

BUILD_PROCESS_WINDOW.returns: window id, number of self-consistent reactor/recycle/separation states, ranges

cost.basis: self-consistent recycle fixed point per state: 0.171 ms/state measured over the full library

OPTIMIZE_PROCESS.returns: lowest-cost feasible state of that candidate in the window (cost, T, P, Tsep, bed volume) or infeasibility with the minimum bed volume

cost.basis: 2 MKM evaluations per not-yet-evaluated state (descriptor bracketing as in the frozen closure) -> states*2/1000 CU

READ_COST_BREAKDOWN.returns: cost pools at that candidate's optimized state

cost.basis: bookkeeping on an already optimized state

RUN_MC.returns: per-candidate feasibility probability and cost quantiles under descriptor uncertainty; among the requested set, P(lowest cost) and pairwise P(lower cost)

cost.basis: per (draw x metal): interpolation on the response-surface asset + full-window cost minimization; wall time measured; the response-surface asset (14136 x 1201 evaluations) is a shared precomputed Layer-A asset, not charged

args.value: perturbed value inside the plausible range

TEST_LEVER.returns: re-optimized cost of each requested candidate under the perturbed parameter

cost.basis: re-optimization of an already evaluated metal under a perturbed economic/engineering parameter; wall time measured

metal_recovery_fraction.description: fraction of spent active metal recovered at replacement (0 = none)

catalyst_life_y.description: catalyst service life before replacement, years

electricity_USD_MWh.description: electricity price, USD/MWh (compression and refrigeration OPEX)

max_catalyst_bed_m3.description: maximum admissible catalyst bed volume, m3 (feasibility gate)

args.pair: [candidate A, candidate B] (both optimized, B feasible)

BACKWARD.returns: intrinsic-activity multiplier of A at which its re-optimized cost equals B's optimized cost, and the state at parity

cost.basis: root search over the activity multiplier, each iteration a full-window re-optimization; wall time measured

TEST_REACHABILITY.returns: largest activity gain obtainable along the frozen descriptor scaling manifold (reference condition; optionally across the window's process states); if a required multiplier is given, classification reachable / marginal / unreachable

cost.basis: reference scope: 1201 MKM evaluations along the descriptor grid; window scope adds the state-wise maximum on the response-surface asset

CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY.returns: validity flags: optimum on a window edge; bed-cap slack / infeasibility; bed volumes below the vessel-correlation floor; exact state-level dominance of a candidate by a reference

cost.basis: bookkeeping, except the exact dominance check on a not-yet-evaluated metal, which costs its state evaluation (2 per state)

stopping_rule.S1: a feasible optimized candidate exists (current lowest-cost candidate identified)
stopping_rule.S2: no unresolved candidate: every candidate is optimized, or is screened as dominated by the current lowest-cost candidate (declared screening rule: lower reference activity AND higher metal price; exact state-level check available via CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY dominance)
stopping_rule.S3: if the highest-activity candidate differs from the lowest-cost candidate, BACKWARD(pair) and TEST_REACHABILITY(required multiplier) have been executed and a classification exists
stopping_rule.S4: the best remaining expected decision value is below the policy's declared threshold, or the remaining budget cannot pay for any admissible action
stopping_rule.may_stop: (S1 and S2 and S3) or budget exhausted; every stop records why_stop, remaining_budget and unresolved_decision_risk

note: action outputs contain only what that computation yields; no action returns another candidate's result or any precomputed answer
